print("=== Remote Debug Start ===")

local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local function list(folder, indent)
    indent = indent or ""
    for _, v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        print(indent .. v.Name .. " [" .. v.ClassName .. "]")
        if #v:GetChildren() > 0 then
            list(v, indent .. "  ")
        end
    end
end

print("Scanning ReplicatedStorage...")
list(rs)

print("=== Debug Done ===")
